papers.title: AI Exposure Scores: what they measure, what they miss, and what comes next
papers.abstract: A set of exposure scores calculated in 2023 has become a central empirical input to the future of work debate. Produced by Eloundou et al. (2023) and referred to here as the GPTs are GPTs scores, they define exposure as the share of occupational tasks a large language model can assist with. This work is a genuine methodological contribution, but as the scores travel from the time and place they were produced, the limitations the authors named do not always travel with them. Two gaps have widened as a result. The first is structural, between what static exposure scores measure and what policy questions actually require. Taking the diffusion of these scores as a case study, we show how their temporal, geographic, and ontological limitations compound in policy-facing analyses, and we survey five families of research responding to these limits: dynamic and benchmark-based measures, ensemble methods, task-framework extensions, worker-centered metrics, and adoption and usage data. The second gap is the one we argue needs more attention: the coordination between researchers and policymakers. The policy-relevant work which ask who is harmed, who benefits, how, and when, continues to reference the static GPTs are GPTs scores without engagement with the methodological updates that would let these questions be answered more reliably. We then ask what additional steps towards navigating uncertainty remain: ex-post frameworks and the deliberate, political work of reimagining what futures are worthy of building towards are. Closing the research-policy gap is a shared task: policymakers must widen their evidence base, engage workers as epistemic partners, and shift from prediction to preparedness; researchers must build data infrastructure, adopt participatory methods, and write with policymakers in mind. Better measurement matters, but it will not close the second gap alone.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】2023年计算得出的一组暴露度评分已成为未来工作相关讨论的核心实证依据。这些评分由Eloundou等人（2023年）提出，被称为“GPTs评分”，它们用于衡量大型语言模型在职业任务中的辅助能力。这项研究确实为方法论领域做出了重要贡献。然而，由于这些评分产生于特定的时间和地点，作者指出的局限性并未随之被完全消除，从而导致了两个方面的问题。第一个问题是方法论上的：静态暴露度评分所测量的内容与政策实际需要了解的信息之间存在差距。以这些评分的传播情况为例，我们分析了其在时间、地理和本体论层面的局限性如何影响政策分析，并探讨了五种应对这些局限性的研究方法：动态评估方法、基于基准的测量方式、任务框架的扩展、以劳动者为中心的评估指标，以及采用和使用数据的相关研究。第二个问题更为关键，即研究者与政策制定者之间的协调不足。许多政策研究仍然依赖于静态的GPTs评分，而没有结合最新的方法论进展来更准确地回答“谁会受到损害、谁会受益、如何受益以及何时受益”等问题。因此，我们进一步探讨了如何应对这些不确定性：需要建立事后评估框架，并通过政治手段重新思考哪些未来值得我们去努力实现。缩小研究政策之间的差距是一...。研究方法：调查数据。

papers.title: Anatomy of the Market: A Body-Tail Test of Factor Models
papers.abstract: I ask whether a factor model that prices the aggregate market also prices the market's internal components. I construct a CRSP investible market portfolio and split it into size-ranked body and tail legs that exactly recombine to the market. All models pass the aggregate market test. Yet q5 leaves systematic, offsetting alphas: negative in the body and positive in the tail. Random splits remove the rejection. The evidence suggests that the market can appear priced because internal pricing errors cancel.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】我探讨了一个问题：一个能够对整体市场进行定价的因子模型，是否也能对市场的各个组成部分进行定价。我构建了一个CRSP可投资市场组合，并将其划分为按规模排序的“主体部分”和“尾部部分”，这两部分能够精确地重新组合成整个市场。所有模型都通过了整体市场的检验。然而，第5个模型仍然存在系统性、相互抵消的异常现象：主体部分的异常值为负，而尾部部分的异常值为正。通过随机划分样本可以消除这种异常现象。证据表明，市场看似被合理定价，是因为内部的定价错误相互抵消了。。

papers.title: A Study on the Impact of Digital Inclusive Finance on County-Level Farmers’ Income in Sichuan Province
papers.abstract: Based on county-level panel data from Sichuan Province from 2014 to 2022 (176 districts and counties), this paper employs a fixed-effects model to empirically examine the impact of digital inclusive finance on rural residents' disposable income. The findings reveal that: (1) digital inclusive finance has a significant positive effect on farmers' income, with a 1% increase in the digital inclusive finance index leading to a 0.347% increase in farmers' income; (2) the level of financial development plays a partial mediating role between digital inclusive finance and farmers' income ; (3) all three dimensions of digital inclusive finance—coverage breadth, usage depth, and degree of digitalization—significantly contribute to the growth of farmers' income; (4) the promoting effect of digital inclusive finance is more pronounced in areas with a high urbanization rate.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：数字普惠金融对四川省县域农民收入有何影响？

🔬 研究方法：基于四川省2014至2022年176个区县的县级面板数据，采用固定效应模型进行实证检验。

📊 核心发现：数字普惠金融显著促进农民收入增长，金融发展水平起部分中介作用，且该效应在覆盖广度、使用深度和数字化程度三个维度上均显著，在高城市化地区更为明显。

💡 应用价值：为政府制定促进农村居民增收的金融政策提供了实证依据。

papers.title: Study on irrational behavior of retail investors in the post-COVID-19 market boom
papers.abstract: Against the backdrop of the COVID-19 pandemic's global economic impact, the subsequent market boom has drawn significant attention, with retail investors demonstrating remarkable activity during this period. Grounded in behavioral finance theory, this study employs literature review, data analysis, case studies, and comparative analysis to investigate irrational decision-making patterns among retail investors during the post-pandemic market rally. The findings reveal that retail investors frequently exhibit herd behavior, chasing "internet-famous stocks" and speculative assets. Social media amplifies overconfidence and "fear of missing out" mentality, leading to short-term price surges and high volatility. These behavioral biases explain price distortions and rapid emotional shifts. The research provides crucial insights for investors to improve decision-making quality and for regulators to promote stable market development.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本研究旨在探讨后疫情时代市场繁荣期间散户投资者的非理性行为模式及其成因。

🔬 研究方法：该研究综合运用了文献综述、数据分析、案例研究以及比较分析等方法。

📊 核心发现：研究发现散户投资者普遍存在羊群效应，热衷于追逐“网红股”和投机性资产；社交媒体的传播加剧了过度自信和错失恐惧症，导致价格扭曲及市场高波动性。

💡 应用价值：该研究为投资者提升决策质量提供了重要参考，同时也为监管者促进市场稳定发展提供了关键见解。

papers.title: Analytic Pricing of Bermudan Swaptions with Few Exercise Dates
papers.abstract: In this paper, we consider pricing a Bermudan swaption with a small number of exercise dates. We begin with the case of two exercise dates.   In this limit, we show that the Bermudan price decomposes into the sum of short-dated European swaptions, setting an upper bound, minus a correction term. This correction is expressed as an integral involving a forward volatility agreement type payoff with start at the first exercise date, and it can be evaluated in closed form. The magnitude of the correction is smaller when variance is front loaded and larger when it is back-loaded.   We extend to three-exercise Bermudans via backward induction under rolling forward measures. A key feature is boundary linearity enabling further analytic steps.   The exercise boundary of options splits into a strike-dependent term and a variance term; together they determine optimal exercise. The linear term is negative, supressing the exponentials in subsequent steps and aiding analytic calculations.   This boundary linearity extends to multiple exercise dates and yields pricing formulas with the same decomposition, showing how optionality accumulates across exercise dates.   We conclude that the Bermudan can be reconstructed by adding, at each exercise date, the initial short swaption with an increasingly higher strike and subtracting the integrated payoffs of all forward-starting receiver swaptions starting at that date. The corresponding double and higher-order integrals decrease rapidly and, in the presence of only a few exercise dates, can be safely neglected without materially impacting the valuation. The general case is discussed at the end.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在本文中，我们研究了具有少量行权日期的百慕大式互换期权的定价问题。我们首先考虑了具有两个行权日期的情形。在这一极限情况下，我们证明了百慕大式互换期权的价值可以表示为短期欧式互换期权价值之和，再加上一个修正项。该修正项是一个积分表达式，涉及从第一个行权日期开始的前向波动率协议型支付函数，并且可以以封闭形式进行计算。当波动率风险在前期集中时（即“前置波动率”），修正项的幅度较小；而当波动率风险在后期集中时（即“后置波动率”），修正项的幅度较大。通过向后归纳法，并结合滚动到期日测度，我们将研究扩展到具有三个行权日期的百慕大式互换期权。一个关键特点是边界线性特性，这使得后续的分析过程变得更加简便。期权的行权边界可以分解为与执行价格相关的部分和与波动率相关的部分；这两部分共同决定了最优的行权时机。线性部分的系数为负，这在后续的计算中起到了抑制指数项增长的作用，从而简化了分析过程。这种边界线性特性同样适用于多个行权日期的情况，从而得到了具有相同分解结构的定价公式，揭示了期权价值如何随着行权日期的增加而累积。我们得出结论：对于百慕大式互换期权，可以通过在每个行权日期将初始的短期互换期权（执行价...。

papers.title: Variance or Standard Deviation? Shell Geometry and Global-Scale Priors in High-Dimensional Shrinkage
papers.abstract: We study how the choice of default prior for a common Gaussian scale affects high-dimensional shrinkage risk, highlighting the role played by high-dimensional geometry. Formally, we consider a high-dimensional setting in which the near-zero behavior of the common scale prior has first-order consequences for shrinkage risk, and show that priors that are flat on the variance and those flat on the standard deviation allocate markedly different mass near the zero-scale boundary, leading to distinct shrinkage behavior and informing principled default prior selection. Specifically, under a radial-power benchmark, we establish that the SD-flat benchmark has a one-unit asymptotic risk advantage near the origin, crosses over in the critical regime, and is second-order equivalent to the variance-flat benchmark for strong signals. Proper single global-scale hyperpriors and bounded coordinate-multiplier mixtures inherit these limits through the near-zero exponent of their SD-scale density. For heavier-tailed or sparse priors, that exponent still classifies the common global-scale component, while local-scale tails, model-size priors, or allocation priors can also affect risk.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们研究了在常见的高斯尺度下，默认先验的选择如何影响高维数据中的收缩风险，并强调了高维几何结构所起的作用。具体而言，我们考虑了一个高维场景，在该场景中，常见尺度先验的接近零的行为会对收缩风险产生直接影响。我们发现，那些在方差或标准差上取平坦分布的先验，在零尺度附近会分配不同的概率质量，从而导致不同的收缩行为，这为选择合适的默认先验提供了理论依据。在径向幂分布的基准模型下，我们证明了标准差平坦分布的先验在原点附近具有单位阶的渐进风险优势；在临界区域，这两种先验的行为会发生变化；而对于强信号而言，它们在二阶意义上是等价的。适当的单一全局尺度超先验以及有界坐标乘数混合先验，通过其标准差尺度密度的接近零的指数特性，能够继承这些性质。对于具有更重尾部或更稀疏分布的先验，该指数仍然能够表征全局尺度成分的影响；而局部尺度尾部、模型大小相关的先验或分配先验也可能对风险产生影响。。

papers.title: Continuous Hidden Markov Models for Equity Returns: Heavy-Tail Emission Families and Regime-Conditional Value-at-Risk
papers.abstract: Synthetic generators of daily equity returns let practitioners stress test, backtest, and design scenarios that a single realized market history cannot supply, but only if the generator reproduces the stylized facts of real returns: heavy tails, negligible linear autocorrelation, and slow decay of the absolute-return autocorrelation. Hidden Markov models with few Gaussian states were long thought unable to reproduce that slow decay, and the standard fix was to abandon them for more complex hidden semi-Markov models. We revisit this issue with a continuous hidden Markov model whose regime chain governs the autocorrelation while per-regime densities govern the marginal, separating the temporal and distributional sides of the original failure. A unified expectation-maximization framework fits Gaussian, Student-t, Laplace, and generalized-error emissions under shared forward-backward recursions and quantile-based initialization, and a spectral identity bounds the number of decay modes by the rank of the centred transition matrix. Across SPY walk-forward folds, a sector-balanced 30-ticker panel, a CRSP cross-decade transfer, and a six-asset basket, that bound was not binding once a few states were used: heavy-tailed marginals, not additional decay modes, closed most of the fit gap, recovering volatility clustering above the i.i.d. baseline and narrowing the kurtosis gap without a tuning hyperparameter. The original failure is therefore distributional, not temporal. On daily US equities, a simple, interpretable Markov model suffices, and unlike a bootstrap or semi-Markov fit that wins only on a single-window fit, the fitted model also yields a regime-conditional Value-at-Risk that passes a joint conditional-coverage test and a copula that reproduces cross-asset correlations: one interpretable generator serving both path simulation and downstream risk and portfolio tasks.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】合成生成的日度股票回报数据为从业者提供了进行压力测试、回测以及设计那些单一历史数据无法实现的情景的工具，但前提是该生成模型能够准确再现真实回报的典型特征：即回报分布具有厚尾特性、线性自相关性极低，以及绝对回报自相关性的衰减过程较为缓慢。长期以来，人们认为具有较少高斯状态的隐马尔可夫模型无法模拟这种缓慢的衰减现象，因此通常会改用更复杂的隐半马尔可夫模型来替代。我们重新探讨了这一问题，提出了一种连续型隐马尔可夫模型：该模型通过“制度链”来控制自相关性，而每个制度下的概率密度则负责描述资产回报的边际分布特征，从而将时间维度和分布维度区分开来。通过统一的期望最大化算法框架，该模型能够处理高斯分布、学生t分布、拉普拉斯分布以及广义误差分布，并支持基于分位数的初始化方法；同时，通过中心化转移矩阵的秩来限制衰减模式的数量。在针对SPY指数、行业均衡的30只股票组合、CRSP指数跨十年数据以及六种资产构成的投资组合进行的实证分析中，当模型中包含足够多的状态时，这一限制条件便不再具有约束力。结果表明：厚尾分布特征而非额外的衰减模式能够解释大部分数据差异，使得模型能够有效捕捉到资产回报的波动聚集现象...。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Equilibrium World Models
papers.abstract: We introduce \emph{Equilibrium World Models} (EWMs), a deep-learning method for globally solving dynamic stochastic models that feature rare disasters, binding constraints, and counterfactual states. Standard unsupervised neural-network-based solvers impose equilibrium conditions only on states generated by their own simulated policy. Their solutions can therefore be self-confirming: accurate on the simulated path, but untested off it, sensitive to initialization, and costly when expectations must be recomputed at each step. EWMs change the computational representation, not the economics. They enforce the model's exact equilibrium conditions on a broader, model-generated distribution of ordinary, rare, stressed, and counterfactual states. They carry the continuation with a learned surrogate, but certify the resulting policy strictly against the true equilibrium conditions. We provide an error decomposition, an off-path residual bound, and a convergence result linking self-confirming solutions to rational-expectations equilibria. We demonstrate EWMs through a sequence of test cases that isolate the main pathologies of classical deep-learning solvers and then scale them to richer economies. In a rare-disaster Brock--Mirman laboratory, coverage reduces disaster-region residuals by an order of magnitude. In a high-dimensional international real-business-cycle model, classical deep-learning solvers fail from all random starts, whereas EWMs converge from nearly all and evaluate continuations up to two orders of magnitude less often. When actions move transition measures, EWMs use action-conditioned continuations to recover the relevant policy margin. In a heterogeneous-agent economy with aggregate risk, EWMs compress the numerical representation of the wealth distribution by at least 25x while imposing exact full-distribution rational-expectations conditions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了“均衡世界模型”（Equilibrium World Models，简称EWMs），这是一种基于深度学习的算法，用于全局求解具有罕见灾害、约束条件以及反事实状态特征的动态随机模型。传统的无监督神经网络求解方法仅对其自身模拟策略生成的状态施加均衡条件，因此其解可能具有自我验证的特性：在模拟路径上准确，但在模拟路径之外无法得到验证，对初始化参数敏感，并且在每一步都需要重新计算期望值时计算成本较高。EWMs改变了模型的计算表示方式，而非其经济逻辑本身；它们在模型生成的普通状态、罕见状态、压力状态以及反事实状态等更广泛的分布范围内强制满足模型的精确均衡条件。EWMs通过学习到的代理模型来实现问题的连续性处理，同时严格验证所得策略是否符合真实的均衡条件。我们提供了误差分解方法、路径外残差界限以及将自我验证解与理性预期均衡联系起来的收敛性证明。通过一系列测试案例，我们展示了EWMs的优势——这些案例揭示了传统深度学习算法的主要缺陷，并将其应用于更复杂的经济模型中。在模拟罕见灾害的Brock-Mirman模型中，EWMs将灾害区域的残差降低了一个数量级；在高维的国际实际商业周期模型中...。研究方法：随机过程、均衡模型。

papers.title: The Expected Number of Pairwise Stable Networks
papers.abstract: This paper studies probabilistic properties of pairwise stability for a network model where individual utilities are random variables. We study the probability that a given network is pairwise stable and the expected number of pairwise stable networks. We provide a closed-form solution for the latter number.   As the evaluation of the exact expression is computationally challenging for large populations, we provide tractable lower and upper bounds for this expression which allow us to pin down the asymptotic behavior of the expected number of pairwise stable networks up to a multiplicative constant. This asymptotic behavior is described by the number of networks $ 2^{n(n-1)/2} $ times $ (2/n+1)^{n} $, a sequence that tends to infinity fast. We normalize the number of pairwise stable networks by this sequence and show that the variance of the normalized number of pairwise stable networks converges to zero as $ n $ tends to infinity.   We conclude that almost surely the number of pairwise stable networks tends to infinity, while the fraction of pairwise stable networks tends to $ 0 $ as $ n $ goes to infinity.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究了一个网络模型中成对稳定性的概率特性，其中各个节点的效用值均为随机变量。我们探讨了给定网络具有成对稳定性的概率，以及成对稳定网络的数量期望值，并为后者提供了一个封闭形式的解。由于对于大规模网络群体而言，精确计算该表达式的数值难度较大，我们提出了该表达式的可行上下界，从而能够确定成对稳定网络数量期望值的渐近行为（其变化范围仅受一个乘法常数的影响）。这种渐近行为表现为网络数量遵循序列 $ 2^{n(n-1)/2} \times (2/n+1)^{n} $，该序列的增长速度非常快。我们用这个序列对成对稳定网络的数量进行归一化，并证明随着 $ n $ 的增大，归一化后的成对稳定网络数量的方差趋于零。研究结果表明：几乎可以肯定的是，成对稳定网络的数量会趋于无穷大；而随着 $ n $ 的增加，成对稳定网络所占的比例会趋近于 $ 0 $。。

papers.title: Remittances and National Peace: The Conditional Roles of Institutional Quality and Income Inequality
papers.venue: Peace Economics, Peace Science and Public Policy
papers.abstract: International remittance flows represent one of the largest sources of external finance for many developing economies, yet their relationship with political stability remains contested. While some studies suggest that remittances are associated with improved household welfare and stability, others indicate that they may coincide with higher levels of unrest or insecurity. This paper examines the relationship between remittance inflows and national peace outcomes using cross-national panel data covering 115 countries from 2008 to 2024. The analysis focuses on the Global Peace Index (GPI), a multidimensional measure capturing domestic security, internal conflict, and militarisation. The study argues that the remittance–peace relationship is conditional rather than uniform and varies across institutional and distributional contexts. Using fixed-effects and dynamic panel estimators, the findings suggest that remittances are positively associated with GPI scores on average, indicating lower levels of peace. However, this association appears weaker in countries characterised by stronger institutional environments and stronger in societies with higher levels of income inequality. Rather than establishing definitive causal effects, the analysis extends existing cross-national research by examining how the remittance–peace relationship varies across institutional and distributional contexts.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：汇款流入如何影响国家和平？这种关系是否受到制度质量和收入不平等的调节？

🔬 研究方法：利用2008至2024年涵盖115个国家的跨国面板数据，采用固定效应和动态面板估计量，以全球和平指数（GPI）作为衡量国家和平的核心指标。

📊 核心发现：研究发现汇款流入平均上与较低的全球和平指数相关，表明和平程度降低；但这种关联在制度环境较强的国家较弱，而在收入不平等较高的社会较强。

💡 应用价值：该研究通过考察汇款与和平关系在不同制度及分配背景下的异质性，为理解汇款对政治稳定的影响提供了新的视角，并强调了政策制定需考虑制度环境差异。

papers.title: Risk rationality and risk sharing in financial institutions: An analysis and criticism of Islamic economics
papers.venue: Muqtasid: Jurnal Ekonomi dan Perbankan Syariah
papers.abstract: This study aimed to establish a philosophical foundation for the conventional financial system from an Islamic perspective, with particular emphasis on usury and risk rationality in the global finance landscape. Using a qualitative library investigative approach, primary data were obtained from articles and books, while secondary data were sourced from financial reports published by various institutions, particularly the Financial Services Authority (OJK). The results showed a positive correlation between the expansion of the interest-based financial sector and rising economic inequality. Conversely, risk-sharing instruments, such as profit-sharing, in Islamic financial institutions presented greater stability in the face of economic shocks and crises. The analysis also identified gaps between philosophical criticism and the practical implementation of contemporary Islamic finance, as well as between the returns on Islamic products and conventional interest rates. In conclusion, ethical and spiritual dimensions should be included in economic theory, as outlined in the Maqâsid al-Sharî’ah. A limitation of this study was the lack of in-depth philosophical analysis grounded in authoritative sources
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本研究旨在从伊斯兰教的角度为传统金融体系建立哲学基础，特别关注全球金融领域中的高利贷问题及风险理性。研究采用定性文献调查方法，主要数据来源于相关文章和书籍，次要数据则来自各类机构（尤其是印度金融监管机构OJK）发布的财务报告。研究结果表明，基于利息的金融部门的扩张与经济不平等的加剧之间存在正相关关系；相比之下，伊斯兰金融机构中的风险共担机制（如利润共享机制）在面对经济冲击和危机时表现出更高的稳定性。分析还揭示了伊斯兰金融在哲学理念与实际应用之间的差距，以及伊斯兰金融产品收益与传统利率之间的差异。最后，研究认为应像《沙里亚目的》（Maqâsid al-Sharî’ah）所倡导的那样，将伦理和精神层面纳入经济理论之中。本研究的局限性在于缺乏基于权威来源的深入哲学分析。。

papers.title: Synergizing Digital Innovation, Sustainability, and Maqashid al-Shariah in the Global Islamic Economy
papers.venue: Share: Jurnal Ekonomi dan Keuangan Islam
papers.abstract: This issue presents an extensive and timely collection of scholarly works that examine the continuing transformation of Islamic economics and finance in response to digital disruption, sustainability imperatives, institutional reform, and changing socio-economic behavior. The articles published in this volume engage with several critical domains, including the digitalization of Islamic social finance, the strengthening of zakat and waqf governance, the expansion of halal industries and halal tourism, the advancement of Islamic banking stability and corporate governance, and the evolving dynamics of Islamic capital markets and financial behavior. In addition, this edition places significant emphasis on the socio-economic application of Maqashid al-Shariah, particularly in the context of digital economic transformation, institutional efficiency, household resilience, and contemporary Islamic financial instruments. Collectively, these contributions offer rigorous theoretical reflections, robust empirical findings, and practical policy recommendations for building an Islamic economy that is ethical, inclusive, adaptive, sustainable, and spiritually grounded in the digital era.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】本期汇集了一系列具有时效性的学术论文，这些论文探讨了伊斯兰经济与金融在面对数字变革、可持续发展要求、制度改革以及社会经济行为变化时的持续转型过程。本卷发表的文章涉及多个关键领域，包括伊斯兰社会金融的数字化、天课（zakat）与瓦克夫（waqf）治理体系的完善、清真产业与清真旅游的拓展、伊斯兰银行业务的稳定性及公司治理的进步，以及伊斯兰资本市场与金融行为的演变趋势。此外，本期特别强调了伊斯兰教法原则（Maqashid al-Shariah）在社会经济实践中的应用，尤其是在数字经济转型、制度效率、家庭韧性以及现代伊斯兰金融工具等方面。总体而言，这些研究不仅提供了严谨的理论分析，还展示了扎实的实证成果，并提出了切实可行的政策建议，旨在构建一个在数字时代具有伦理性、包容性、适应性强、可持续性，并且基于伊斯兰教精神的伊斯兰经济体系。。
